name: Sime Darby Berhad
summary: Sime Darby Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, provides automotive and industrial equipment in Malaysia, China, Australasia, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Industrial, Motors, UMW, and Others segments. The company sells new and used heavy equipment sales and power systems; equipment rental; other rental services; product support; industrial solutions; and distributes Caterpillar products for resources, infrastructure, maritime, power generation, oil and gas, material handling, and agriculture companies.
